sentences.en: ROSIE: Colin, I'm really struggling to think of a topic for our human geography assignment
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 科林，我实在想不出我们人文地理学作业的主题。

sentences.en: COLIN: Me too, Rosie
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我也是，罗茜。

sentences.en: I'll tell you what, let's think about the different aspects of human geography and see if we can narrow the topic down a bit to help us decide
sentences.zh: 我有个主意，咱们先想想人文地理学的不同方面，看看能不能把主题范围缩小一点，以便做出决定。

sentences.en: ROSIE: OK
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 好啊。

sentences.en: So one aspect is population
sentences.zh: 比如其中一个方面是人口。

sentences.en: That would be all about population density and migration and so on
sentences.zh: 这主要涉及人口密度、人口迁移等等。

sentences.en: Lots of facts and statistics
sentences.zh: 会有很多事实和统计数据。

sentences.en: Maybe a bit boring?
sentences.zh: 也许有点枯燥？

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah, but quite straightforward to find on the internet
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，但在网上找起来倒是很直接明了。

sentences.en: ROSIE: Suppose so
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 也许吧。

sentences.en: How about health?
sentences.zh: 那健康呢？

sentences.en: I'd never thought about the links between that and geography until Professor Lee gave us that lecture on cholera
sentences.zh: 直到李教授给我们讲了霍乱那场讲座之前，我从没想过健康与地理之间还有这种联系。

sentences.en: How in the 19th century, a physician used street plans and plans of water supplies to find the source of a cholera epidemic
sentences.zh: 比如19世纪一位医生曾利用街道地图和供水系统图，找到了霍乱疫情的源头。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yes, fascinating, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 没错，真令人着迷，对吧？

sentences.en: Or we could do something more general like economies
sentences.zh: 或者我们也可以选个更宽泛些的主题，比如经济。

sentences.en: ROSIE: So how financial and commercial factors are linked to the physical environment
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 就是探讨金融和商业因素如何与自然环境相关联。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah
sentences.zh: COLIN: 对。

sentences.en: ROSIE: I thought that had been taken off the syllabus for this year
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我以为这个主题今年已从教学大纲中删去了。

sentences.en: COLIN: Has it
sentences.zh: COLIN: 真删了吗？

sentences.en: ROSIE: I not sure but it might be best to avoid it
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我不太确定，但或许最好还是避开它。

sentences.en: COLIN: OK
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好的。

sentences.en: Maybe we could do something on culture
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以做关于文化方面的内容。

sentences.en: We had that lecture about culture and geography last week
sentences.zh: 我们上周听了关于文化和地理的讲座。

sentences.en: ROSIE: I didn't get much out of that
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我从那场讲座中收获甚微。

sentences.en: It was all so general and the lecturer didn't give any useful examples
sentences.zh: 内容太过笼统，而且讲师没有给出任何有用的实例。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah, I hardly took any notes
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，我几乎没记什么笔记。

sentences.en: It didn't seem worth it
sentences.zh: 感觉不值得花时间。

sentences.en: ROSIE: Me neither
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我也是。

sentences.en: COLIN: We could focus on poverty
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我们可以聚焦于贫困问题。

sentences.en: That's something that's a global problem
sentences.zh: 这是一个全球性的问题。

sentences.en: ROSIE: The trouble is, Dr Lee was saying, that you have to be careful with some of the figures relating to poverty
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 麻烦在于，李博士曾提到，你必须谨慎对待一些与贫困相关的数据。

sentences.en: They're sometimes deliberately man: ipulated
sentences.zh: 这些数据有时是被刻意操纵的。

sentences.en: COLIN: You mean the information gets changed for political reasons?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 你的意思是，信息会出于政治原因而被篡改？

sentences.en: ROSIE: That sort of thing, yes
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 没错，就是这类情况。

sentences.en: ROSIE: So what are we going to do our assignment on?
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 那么我们的作业到底要写什么主题呢？

sentences.en: I'll tell you what
sentences.zh: 我有个主意。

sentences.en: One of the possibilities we have discussed is urbanisation and now over half the world population lives in cities
sentences.zh: 我们之前讨论过的可能性之一是城市化——目前全球超过一半的人口居住在城市中。

sentences.en: That really important
sentences.zh: 这确实非常重要。

sentences.en: COLIN: OK good idea Rosie: Let do that
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好主意，罗茜！我们就选这个吧。

sentences.en: ROSIE: I love living in a big city but of course there are problems
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我很喜欢住在大城市，但当然也存在一些问题。

sentences.en: COLIN: Things like theft and robbery?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 像盗窃和抢劫这类事情？

sentences.en: ROSIE: Yes, but where I come from, that's linked to another more serious issue, which is that a lot of people don't have jobs
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，但在我的家乡，这与另一个更严重的问题相关联，即很多人没有工作。

sentences.en: That's getting worse and worse
sentences.zh: 这种情况正变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: And we also still have quite a lot of people who are homeless, though that's not quite so bad as it was
sentences.zh: 此外，我们仍然有相当多的无家可归者，尽管这一状况已不像过去那么严重了。

sentences.en: COLIN: It would be nice to talk about some positive dev: elopments, like some of the new dev: elopments on the outskirts of cities
sentences.zh: COLIN: 谈谈一些积极的发展情况会很不错，比如城市郊区的一些新开发项目。

sentences.en: ROSIE: Yeah, they've opened some massive new shopping centres outside my city
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，他们在我所在的城市郊外新建了一些超大型购物中心。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah, the same with mine, but it means a lot of the shops in the city centre are closing down
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是的，我的城市也是如此，但这意味着市中心的许多商店正在陆续关闭。

sentences.en: But the outskirts are ideal for buildings that need a lot of space, like for conferences
sentences.zh: 不过，郊区非常适合建造需要大量空间的建筑，比如会议中心。

sentences.en: They've opened a couple of big ones
sentences.zh: 他们已经建成了几家大型会议中心。

sentences.en: ROSIE: Yes, we've got some too
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，我们那里也有一些。

sentences.en: It'd be nicer to have more facilities for things like football too, but that's not happening where I live
sentences.zh: 要是能多建一些足球等运动设施就更好了，但在我住的地方，这并未发生。

sentences.en: COLIN: Same in my area
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我所在的地区情况也一样。

sentences.en: ROSIE: We could include something about dev: eloping disused industrial sites
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 我们还可以提一提对废弃工业用地的再开发。

sentences.en: It seems like a good idea because you're not doing any harm to the natural environment
sentences.zh: 这似乎是个好主意，因为这样做不会对自然环境造成任何损害。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah, but aren't the buildings architecturally significant?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，但那些建筑在建筑学上不是具有重要意义吗？

sentences.en: ROSIE: Not really
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 并不 really（实际上）如此。

sentences.en: And what people forget is that they often used quite dangerous materials, chemicals and things, which haven't been properly cleared away, so the whole site has to be made safe
sentences.zh: 而人们往往忘记的是，这些旧厂房曾使用过相当危险的材料，比如化学品等，而这些危险物质并未得到妥善清除，因此整个场地都必须进行安全处理。

sentences.en: COLIN: Hmm, that can't be cheap
sentences.zh: COLIN: 嗯，这肯定不便宜。

sentences.en: And I bet it's often not budgeted for
sentences.zh: 而且我敢打赌，这类开支常常未被纳入预算。

sentences.en: ROSIE: You're right
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 您说得对。

sentences.en: COLIN: Have you read about Masdar City?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 你读过关于马斯达尔城的报道吗？

sentences.en: ROSIE: In Abu Dhabi?
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 在阿布扎比？

sentences.en: Yes
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was designed to be a green city, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 它原本的设计目标是一座绿色城市，对吧？

sentences.en: That might be a good example of a city which set out to depend entirely on renewable energy
sentences.zh: 这或许是一个很好的范例，即一座从一开始就立志完全依赖可再生能源的城市。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yes we should say something about that It was designed to be totally pedestrianised too wasn't it with the transport underground
sentences.zh: COLIN: 没错，我们应当提一下这一点。它当初的设计还旨在实现彻底的无车化，对吧？交通系统全部设于地下。

sentences.en: ROSIE: Yes and they had big plans for recycling to reduce waste to the lowest possible level But let's stick to talking about power sources
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 是的，而且他们曾制定了宏大的回收利用计划，以将废弃物减至最低水平。不过，咱们还是聚焦在能源来源上吧。

sentences.en: COLIN: Then there's that ecotown in England, Greenhill Abbotts
sentences.zh: COLIN: 还有英国那个生态小镇——格林希尔·阿博茨。

sentences.en: It set out to conform to the usual principles, sustainability and so on
sentences.zh: 它最初的目标是遵循常规的可持续发展等原则。

sentences.en: A lot of people were against it at first
sentences.zh: 起初，许多人对此表示反对。

sentences.en: They said the plans were unrealistic
sentences.zh: 他们称这些规划不切实际。

sentences.en: I'm not sure how far they've got with it
sentences.zh: 我不太确定该项目目前进展到了什么程度。

sentences.en: I'll check
sentences.zh: 我会去查证一下。

sentences.en: ROSIE: Right
sentences.zh: ROSIE: 好的。

sentences.en: So it looks as if we have a sort of plan
sentences.zh: 看来我们已大致拟定了一个方案。
